subject: 970 Fellsway Chapter 40B Comprehensive Permit
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals reviewed draft conditions and requested local regulatory waivers for a proposed 289-unit Chapter 40B development at 970 Fellsway. The board continued the hearing to May 21, 2024, without taking a vote on the permit, and approved prior meeting minutes.

items.title: 970 Fellsway (Case 40B-2023-01) Comprehensive Permit Review
items.summary: Special counsel and the board reviewed draft approval conditions and an updated waiver list with the applicant's team for a proposed 289-unit Chapter 40B development, discussing traffic demand management, fire safety, parking restrictions, and linkage fees before continuing the hearing to May 21, 2024.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes for March 26, April 11, and April 23, 2024.
